event: His one open eye is empty and tired; he does not struggle, only bleeds.
Wren wades in with the kin-fire, asking where Alan's hands should go.
Light him with the kin-fire, Alan says, and goes for the taps himself.
Eyes shut, he feels each open tap and closes every one he can reach.
The highest throat-taps are out of his reach, still running.
Wren tips the kin-fire onto him; it knows his blood and closes the wounds.
